meta.name: Time Bandits
meta.description:
Eleven-year-old Kevin's passion for history is put to the test when he joins a ragtag group of time-traveling thieves on a high-stakes and hilarious adventure.

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10

videos.title: Kevin Haddock
videos.overview: A boy struggles to make the most of everyday life—until a bumbling gang of thieves lands in his bedroom.

videos.title: Mayan
videos.overview: On a whirlwind journey to ancient Mexico, Kevin and the Bandits take part in a feast. Pure Evil sends huntress Fianna on a quest.

videos.title: Medieval
videos.overview: The Bandits pose as dragon slayers in England and feel the wrath of a wicked sheriff. Saffron embarks on her own search for answers.

videos.title: Prohibition
videos.overview: Kevin and the Bandits run for their lives during New York's Harlem Renaissance. Saffron and an ally work to outwit enemies in Japan.

videos.title: Georgian
videos.overview: While searching for Kevin's home, the Bandits cross paths with Casanova and the Earl of Sandwich. Penelope is challenged to a duel.

videos.title: Mansa Musa
videos.overview: The Bandits scour the desert for a missing member and hatch a plan to rob history's richest man. Widgit delves into the mysteries of the Map.

videos.title: Ice Age
videos.overview: Saffron saves the day in an icy situation. Penelope faces off with a tribal chief. Bittelig puts his heart into a rescue mission.

videos.title: Home Again
videos.overview: Kevin and Saffron return to Bingley...but it's 1996 and their parents are children. Fianna continues her chase and crashes a goth party.

videos.title: Pell-Mell
videos.overview: The gang sets out to find the missing piece of the Map. Kevin comes face-to-face with the Supreme Being, who offers a tempting deal.

videos.title: Fortress of Darkness
videos.overview: Despite impossible odds, Kevin, Saffron, and the Bandits venture into the Fortress of Darkness to save Kevin's parents.
